description:
For the grave sins of pride and insatiable greed, the majestic God of Winter is stripped of his divinity and cast down to the mortal realm as a cruel punishment. Stranded in a weak, fragile human body, he is desperate to reclaim his rightful place among the heavens. However, the path to restoring his godly status is paved with a singular, horrific condition: he must consume the living heart of the person he loves most. 

As the fallen deity navigates the foreign emotions of mortality, he unexpectedly finds himself falling deeply in love, binding his fate to a human soul. Now, trapped in a agonizing paradox, Cheong-Hwi must choose between his eternal ambition and his newfound devotion to his lover, Gaeddong. To become a god once more, he must destroy his own salvation by plunging his love into a cold, bloody tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
